subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this locked, pinned 20-open-PR policy notice remain open as the canonical GitHub announcement now that docs and automation already match it?
rationale: The repository source and latest release already implement the policy, but Takhoffman reopened and pinned the notice after the original docs closure, so automation should not infer that the notice is disposable.

options.title: Keep the notice open and pinned
options.body: Leave the issue as the visible policy announcement while docs and automation continue to enforce the 20-PR cap.

options.title: Close after replacing the announcement surface
options.body: Close the issue only after maintainers choose a different public policy surface, such as the contribution guide or a pinned discussion.

options.title: Unpin but keep open
options.body: Keep the policy discussion available without using it as a top-level pinned announcement.

recommendation.title: Keep the notice open and pinned
recommendation.body: Leave the issue as the visible policy announcement while docs and automation continue to enforce the 20-PR cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the latest explicit policy-state changes on this issue: rename to 20, pin, and reopen.
